canonical_project: Koramco Busan Jangrim Data Center (Koramco Jangrim IDC)
notes: Koramco announced 29 Aug 2025 development of a 'Massive' data center in Jangrim-dong, Saha-gu, Busan: ~46,900 sqm floor area, 40 MW utility power (sucheon capacity), ~KRW 5.8 trillion-scale project within Koramco's KRW 5 trillion DC fund plan through 2028; construction start planned as of Aug 2025.
